studies.title: From Ephemeral Inference to Compiled Agency: A Position Paper on Verifiable, Energy-Accounted Computing
studies.hook_headline: Compiled Agency · 81.86x FP32 Unpack Tax vs 26.58x KV260 & 16.26x Thor Shunt Cascade
studies.headline_metric: 26.58x KV260 INA260 & 16.26x Thor INA3221 Cascade Cut (measured_j @ 813eb96)
plain_bullets: Compressing weights 52.72x backfires by 81.86x on Kria KV260 physical DC shunts if unpacked to FP32 on every query.
Keeping arithmetic in packed integers beats dense INT8 by 4.13x on KV260 and 7.95x on Jetson Thor while waiOS halts on single-weight tamper.
A 4-stage lookup-first cascade cuts KV260 INA260 energy 26.58x gross (24.49x net) and Thor INA3221 energy 16.26x, avoiding 38.46x Stage-4 calls.
studies.energy_disclosure: AMD Kria KV260 TI INA260 SOM_5V_DC & NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor TI INA3221 VDD_CPU_SOC_MSS shunts (measured_j), strictly orthogonal to Linux RAPL reported_j & cloud est_j.
studies.tiktok_caption:
From Ephemeral Inference to Compiled Agency — 81.86x FP32 Unpack Tax vs. 26.58x KV260 & 16.26x Thor Shunt Cascade (measured_j @ 813eb96)

Compressing a 512x512 matrix 52.72x (0.1517 bpw) then unpacking to FP32 cost 81.86x MORE energy than INT8 on Kria KV260 TI INA260 (63,335.56 vs 773.74 uJ measured_j). Staying in Packed Integer cut INT8 4.13x (187.49 uJ), 4-ISA waiOS halted on Row-77 tamper (0/400 drift), and the 4-stage lookup cascade cut KV260 INA260 measured_j 26.58x gross / 24.49x net and Jetson Thor INA3221 measured_j 16.26x.

studies.hook_headline: Time as an Index · 31 Machine-Checked Proofs · 0 Time Shortcuts

studies.headline_metric: 0 Replay Drift Across 3 OSes · 9/9 Suites Pass
plain_bullets: Using exact whole-number physics, one game blueprint replays identically for hours across Windows, macOS, Linux, and major engines.
Standard decimal math drifts across operating systems within thirty-seven frames, and chaotic collisions quickly amplify tiny rounding gaps.
Graphics cards vary slightly pixel by pixel, so visual rendering must sit downstream behind a strict one-way tolerance gate.

studies.headline_metric: 125–176 nJ Board Sensor · 38 ns Cycle · 55.2 °C M.2 Bound
plain_bullets: Living cells use sixty-four genetic triplets to store survival rules, and digital six-input lookup tables use the exact same sixty-four switches.
Grouping four neighboring switch settings together absorbs small sensor or wording glitches while eliminating brittle high-frequency noise.
A sixteen-kilobyte core runs verified skills in nanoseconds from four-dollar microcontrollers to fanless M.2 circuit cards, waking large models only on genuine novelty.
